The main takeaway from our work is that
SRBSDV can produce vsiRNAs from all ten genomic segments, and the production of vsiRNA from the 10 genomic segments are not strand-specific, but vary in abundance.
the SRBSDV vsiRNAs are abundant in infected rice and can target a large number of rice genes, which might be involved in host defense, pathogenesis, and host-virus interaction.
